messages:
asha: short thread: deciding transport strategy. proto-first inside mesh + gateway transcode vs JSON passthrough. hit points: quota/attribution, telemetry mapping, canary UX, error semantics.

mike: proto-first for internal APIs. typed contracts + smaller payloads. gateway transcode doable but must be lossless and observable.

rebecca: we cant collapse method identity at the edge. need canonical markers from gateway: `x-canonical-service`, `x-canonical-method`, `x-proto-sha`. that lets billing and console map to the right metric.

tess: console requirement: be able to show both "transport-observed" and "canonical-method" metrics side-by-side. also surface transcode errors as their own metric.

devex: rollout: feature-flag transcode. plan: opt-in tenants -> small canary -> wider. have fallback: if transcode fails, gateway falls back to passthrough and emits `x-transcode-fallback:true`.

gatewaybot: Deploy note: transcode-canary enabled for group proto-spike-2 at 2026-04-02T14:00:00Z.

mike: propose header map: `x-canonical-service: inference.v1.ModelService`, `x-canonical-method: Generate`, `x-original-path: /v1/generate`, `x-tenant-id: t-abc123`, `x-proto-sha: 9f2b`. gateway will always attach `x-transport-observed`.

rebecca: quota enforcement: gateway should do pre-checks and stamp `x-quota-id` and `x-quota-window`. on limit return consistent JSON: `\{"error\":\"quota_exceeded\",\"quota\":\"tokens\",\"remaining\":0\}`. downstreams may re-validate.

tess: streaming semantics: gRPC streaming -> SSE/chunked for HTTP clients. document differences. avoid trying to emulate bidi on HTTP; mark as "unsupported" if client requires bidi.

devex: canary success criteria: transcode 5xx delta <5%, transcode-fallback rate <0.1%, p50 latency regression <3ms. if break, auto roll back.

mike: implementation notes: sidecar transcode will preserve original body in `x-original-payload-sha` when conversions are lossy; emit `x-transcode-status: ok|partial|error`.

rebecca: telemetry: gateway logs must include canonical_route, observed_transport, proto_sha, transcode_latency_ms. create a join in ingestion to map traces -> canonical routes for historical continuity.

asha: action items:
- mike: build sidecar spike (2w)
- tess: console dual-view + transcode-error dashboard mock
- rebecca: telemetry joiner and quota header spec
- devex: detailed canary playbook and feature flags

taskbot: Created task INF-1533: proto-first transcode spike -> assignees: mike, tess, rebecca, devex

mike: starting spike Monday, will push a smoke PR.

tess: mockup by Thu.

asha: thanks everyone, sync Fri 11am for status.

tess: :thumbsup:
